title: Independent TD-DFT test of triaryl-heptazine optical assignments
difficulty_reasons: The four molecular identities and observables are fixed, but the agent must choose a defensible computational route, validate minima, select visible states and analyze orbital contributions.

paper.title: Triaryl-Heptazine Photocatalysts for the Oxidation of C–H and C–C Bonds in Nitrogen-Containing Molecules

data.description: Four source-supported, RDKit/Open Babel-validated neutral-singlet identities with formulas and parseable SMILES; 3-D coordinates remain agent-generated.

required_deliverables.description: Validated calculations, transitions, orbital localization, hypothesis test, provenance and limitations.
